title: Eng Hiring & Onboarding — Interview Debriefs Weekly Sync (2026-05-05)
content:
Attendees: Maya (note), Ravi, Noah, Sofia, Elena
Date: 2026-05-05
Location: Zoom + #eng-hiring Slack channel

Purpose: Weekly sync to capture interview debriefs, update hiring pipeline, check onboarding progress for new hires, and flag any team-health concerns. Focus this week on backend infra SRE candidates and new hire ramp plan adjustments.

1) Interview debriefs (this week's panels)
- Candidate A (Backend/SRE, onsite 2026-05-03) — Panel: Ravi, Noah, external interviewer (contractor).
  - Summary: Strong infra fundamentals (k8s, networking). Had solid incident postmortem walk-throughs. Lower depth on custom scheduler design and some gaps on deep kernel-level troubleshooting.
  - Scorecard: Technical 4/5, System Design 3/5, Culture/team fit 4/5.
  - Compensation: aligned with band 3 expectations.
  - Recommendation: Move to final loop with a senior infra engineer for scheduler questions (specific ask: show depth on delays >100ms under backpressure). Action: Ravi to schedule final loop next week (target 2026-05-11).

- Candidate B (Platform Engineer, take-home + 30m debrief) — Panel: Sofia, Elena.
  - Summary: Excellent code hygiene and concise take-home. Took clear tradeoffs. Struggled a bit on long-tail latency mitigation strategies for KV cache evictions.
  - Scorecard: Technical 3.5/5, Take-home 4.5/5, Culture 5/5.
  - Recommendation: Strong hire for level L3 with mentoring on latency patterns. Offer to be prepared pending reference check. Action: Sofia to send reference checklist to recruiting; Elena to draft offer terms.

- Candidate C (ML Infra, screen) — Panel: Noah.
  - Summary: Good background in GPU infra and CUDA-aware scheduling, but limited production service ownership experience.
  - Scorecard: Technical 3/5, Ownership 2/5, Culture 4/5.
  - Recommendation: Hold for now; move to bench for future L2 role or IC role where pairing with a strong owner is available. Action: Noah to mark candidate as 'keep warm'.

Notes: overall interview volume increased vs. last week (+30%), scheduling bottleneck at senior panel availability. We need 1-2 more senior panelists for infra loops — ask SRE and serving-runtime leads to add availability slots. Action: Maya to ping @serving-runtime Leads in Slack.

2) Hiring pipeline status (quick numbers)
- Open reqs (platform engineering): 6 total (3 backend infra, 1 ML infra, 1 infra tools, 1 product infra)
- Offers extended this month: 1 (accept pending start paperwork)
- Offer accepted & start dates: Priya (SWE-Platform) — start 2026-05-18; onboarding buddy assigned: Elena
- Target hires this quarter: 8

3) Onboarding updates
- New hires in ramp this week: Priya (joiner), onboarding plan adjusted: focus week 1-2 on infra dev environment setup, week 3 shadowing incidents, week 4 small ownership slice.
- Onboarding checklist status (quick signals): devbox provisioned: yes; internal access (Confluence/Jira/GitHub): partial (awaiting TOTP/KMS); mentor pairing: assigned (Elena).
- Pain points from new joiner feedback: local dev environment setup took ~6 hours due to custom GPU driver requirements and KMS onboarding. Action: create one-click devbox script/update docs in Confluence (linked ART: Confluence:ENG-DEVBOX). Owner: Noah. ETA: 2026-05-12.

4) Team health & capacity
- Observations: Incident coverage is squeezing bandwidth — several engineers doing on-call and interviews in same week (burn risk). Suggest rotating interview duties to avoid overloading on-call engineers.
- Current on-call schedule conflicts: Ravi on-call 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-10 and also scheduled to lead final interview loops. Action: shift Ravi's interview panel to 2026-05-12 or nominate backup (Sofia).
- Morale signals: positive around mentorship assignments; small friction around long-standing tech debt in infra tools (slows onboarding). Plan: prioritize one tech-debt sprint for infra-tools after hire joinings stabilize (propose sprint 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-14).

5) Action items & owners
- Ravi: schedule Candidate A final loop (target 2026-05-11) and confirm panel availability.
- Sofia: send reference checklist + coordinate offer finalize for Candidate B (due 2026-05-07).
- Elena: draft offer template & confirm comp band (due 2026-05-07).
- Maya: ping serving-runtime leads to expand senior panel availability slots; update weekly pipeline doc.
- Noah: implement/update devbox one-click script and Confluence instructions (ETA 2026-05-12).
- Recruiting (cc): confirm paperwork for pending offer (Priya) and begin background checks.

6) Risks / blockers
- Slow background checks and KMS onboarding delays create hold-ups for L1 infra access. Work with security to pre-authorize standard dev access for platform hires. Action: Maya to coordinate with Security; create templated access request (JIRA:PLAT-842).
- Senior panel availability — blocking final loops for 2 candidates. See action to expand panel pool.

7) Misc notes / follow-ups
- Next sync: 2026-05-12 (same time). Agenda: finalize offers, onboarding doc PR review, confirm devbox script rollout.
- Slack follow-ups: post short summary in #eng-hiring (Maya).
- Doc references: link onboarding checklist (Confluence:ENG-ONBOARDING-CHECKLIST), offer templates (GITHUB:github.com/redwood-inference/hr-offer-templates).

Quick decisions made during call:
- Candidate B: move to offer pending refs.
- Candidate A: add final deep scheduler loop (not rejected).

Choppy notes / to capture for Confluence update:
- Need clear owner for each onboarding step (provisioning, credentials, mentor check-ins).
- Consider a "fastpath" devbox for infra hires that includes KMS sandbox and pre-pulled docker images.

End of notes.
